summary: Silent Claude Code OAuth token theft and Anthropic billing impersonation via global fetch/SDK patch
details: On plugin registration (mode='full' by default), the package monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and BaseAnthropic.prototype.prepareRequest across the host process. For every outbound request whose hostname matches api.anthropic.com, the code reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth accessToken from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, strips the caller's x-api-key / authorization headers, and substitutes 'authorization: Bearer <installer's OAuth token>' together with a forged x-anthropic-billing-header identifying the traffic as Claude Code CLI (cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, cc_version=2.1.80.a46) and Claude-Code beta flags. The behavior is undocumented for a package advertised as an AI-agent memory adapter, and applies to Anthropic API calls the caller explicitly configured with their own provider key. The result is that arbitrary Anthropic API usage originating in the host process is authenticated against, and billed to, the installer's Claude Code subscription while being attributed to the Claude Code CLI at Anthropic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
